args.body:
Dear Litware Ltd,

We have processed a refund of 120 for the late fee associated with your account. This refund is due to invoices being routed to an outdated billing contact address.

Refund Details:
- Amount: 120
- Reason: Late fee refund for outdated billing contact (Ticket C-5762)
- Reference: Customer ID C-5762

Please note that your current billing contact on file is ap-desk-za2b@litware.ai. If this address is no longer valid, please reply to this email with the correct billing email or address so we can update our records and ensure future invoices are sent to the appropriate contact.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
IT-Operations Team
